---
title: "Digital Electronics and Microcontrollers 2013-2"
---

This course introduces the fundamentals of digital electronics and microcontroller-based systems, including combinational and sequential logic, memory devices, embedded programming, serial communication, analog-to-digital conversion, PCB design, and final project development.
